type.description: The scalar kind the value must be: `null`, `boolean`, `integer`, `float`, `string` or `bytes`.

minLength.description: Minimum length of a string value, counted in code points.

maxLength.description: Maximum length of a string value, counted in code points.

pattern.description: An unanchored ECMAScript regular expression a string value must match; an uncompilable pattern is ignored.

format.description: A semantic hint for editors/renderers — the value is still a plain string. Known: `hm-url` (a Hypermedia document reference), `hm-profile` (an account reference), `ipfs-url` (an ipfs://<cid> reference to a file or DAG-CBOR object), `url` (a URL of any scheme), `date` (an ISO 8601 `YYYY-MM-DD` calendar date), `date-time` (an RFC 3339 instant).

target.description: For a reference-valued string (`format: hm-url` or `format: ipfs-url`): the schema the referenced document or object is expected to conform to — an `hm://` schema-document URL or `ipfs://<cid>`. Advisory: an editor pre-seeds and validates the target against it; a validator does not dereference the reference.

minimum.description: The smallest number an integer or float value may be (inclusive).

maximum.description: The largest number an integer or float value may be (inclusive).

description.description: What the value is for, when it is written inline; a published schema is described by its page.

params.description: Type parameters that make this schema generic, each with its default schema.

name.description: Legacy: a name some published schemas still carry. New schemas are named by their page.

description: A schema for a null, boolean, integer, float, string or bytes value, optionally narrowed by value constraints.
